procedures.name: Banking Court Execution Auction of Mortgaged Property

steps.name: Valuation of Mortgaged Property
steps.rule: Must be conducted by independent evaluators from Pakistan Banks' Association (PBA) approved panel

steps.name: Fixing Reserve Price
steps.rule: Banking Court fixes reserve price based on PBA valuation. Grossly inadequate reserve price without valuation constitutes material irregularity.

steps.name: Proclamation of Sale
steps.rule: Public proclamation published in widely circulated national daily newspapers giving full property description, encumbrances, and reserve price.
steps.authorities: FIO 2001 s.19, Order XXI Rule 66 CPC

steps.name: Objection Petition under Order XXI Rule 90 CPC
steps.rule: Must be filed within 30 days of auction (Art. 166 Limitation Act). Court may require deposit (statutory baseline 20% second proviso). Non-compliance risks summary dismissal.

steps.name: Adjudication of Objections Before Confirmation
steps.rule: Auction confirmation is conditional upon substantive examination of objections on merits; auction cannot be confirmed while objections are pending.

steps.name: Appellate Remedy
steps.rule: Appeal lies exclusively to High Court under Section 22 FIO 2001 within 30 days before Division Bench. Section 109 CPC and District Judge appeals are barred.
